verdict.rationale: Warp documents two official CLIs. The Oz CLI runs and manages cloud agents from any terminal, script, or CI pipeline, with API-key auth, agent profiles and MCP connections. The standalone Warp Agent CLI (`warp` command) works in any terminal, over SSH, or where the app isn't installed. A probe confirms the CLI reference page exists. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI's behavior in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Oz CLI is the command-line tool for running and managing Warp’s cloud agents from any terminal, script, or CI pipeline.
The Warp Agent is now available as a standalone CLI that you can use anywhere
Run the `warp` command to start a conversation in any terminal emulator, over SSH, or on a machine where the Warp app isn't installed.
API keys let the Oz CLI, cloud agents, and self-hosted workers authenticate without human interaction.
